description: Agent Template Library (20+ Python archetype dataclasses) and Additional LLM Providers (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Gemini adapters). Expands the template system from Markdown-only to include rich Python dataclasses, and adds 3 new LLM adapters following the existing BaseAdapter pattern.
steps: Create src/nexus/templates/archetypes.py with: (1) AgentArchetype dataclass (name str, role str, capabilities list[str], constraints list[str], system_prompt str, tools_allowed list[str], interaction_style str, description str). (2) Define 20 archetype instances: SOFTWARE_ARCHITECT, BACKEND_ENGINEER, FRONTEND_ENGINEER, QA_ENGINEER, DEVOPS_ENGINEER, SECURITY_ENGINEER, DATA_ENGINEER, ML_ENGINEER, PRODUCT_MANAGER, TECH_WRITER, DESIGNER, RESEARCHER, PROJECT_MANAGER, SCRUM_MASTER, SITE_RELIABILITY_ENGINEER, DATABASE_ADMIN, MOBILE_DEVELOPER, PERFORMANCE_ENGINEER, ACCESSIBILITY_SPECIALIST, TEAM_LEAD. Each must have meaningful capabilities (3-6 items), constraints (2-4 items), a system_prompt (multi-line string describing role), tools_allowed (2-5 items), and interaction_style (e.g., 'collaborative', 'directive', 'analytical'). (3) Create an ArchetypeRegistry class with get_archetype(name), list_archetypes(), get_archetypes_by_role(role) methods.

Create src/nexus/adapters/azure_adapter.py following the pattern in openai_adapter.py: AzureOpenAIAdapter extending BaseAdapter. adapter_type='azure_openai'. validate_config requires 'api_key', 'model', 'azure_endpoint', 'api_version'. _do_execute calls Azure OpenAI endpoint (https://{endpoint}/openai/deployments/{model}/chat/completions?api-version={version}). Include MODEL_PRICING dict, retry logic, proper headers (api-key header). Capabilities: execute_task, function_calling, conversation_history, system_prompt, retry_on_rate_limit.

Create src/nexus/adapters/bedrock_adapter.py: BedrockAdapter extending BaseAdapter. adapter_type='bedrock'. validate_config requires 'aws_access_key_id', 'aws_secret_access_key', 'region', 'model'. _do_execute constructs AWS Signature V4 signed request to Bedrock InvokeModel endpoint. Include MODEL_PRICING for Claude on Bedrock and Titan models. Capabilities: execute_task, conversation_history, system_prompt, retry_on_rate_limit.

Create src/nexus/adapters/google_adapter.py: GoogleGeminiAdapter extending BaseAdapter. adapter_type='google_gemini'. validate_config requires 'api_key', 'model'. _do_execute calls https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent. Include MODEL_PRICING for gemini-2.0-flash, gemini-1.5-pro, gemini-1.5-flash. Capabilities: execute_task, function_calling, conversation_history, system_prompt, retry_on_rate_limit.
Update src/nexus/adapters/registry.py: Add imports and register 'azure_openai', 'bedrock', 'google_gemini' in _register_defaults().
Update src/nexus/adapters/__init__.py to export the 3 new adapter classes.
Update src/nexus/templates/__init__.py to export AgentArchetype, ArchetypeRegistry.

Create tests/test_archetypes.py: Test AgentArchetype dataclass creation, all 20 archetypes have required fields populated, ArchetypeRegistry.get_archetype/list_archetypes/get_archetypes_by_role work correctly. At least 12 test methods.

Create tests/test_provider_adapters.py: Test AzureOpenAIAdapter, BedrockAdapter, GoogleGeminiAdapter - config validation (missing keys), session creation, successful execute with mocked httpx response, rate limit retry, error handling. At least 15 test methods (5 per adapter).
acceptance_criteria: src/nexus/templates/archetypes.py exists with AgentArchetype dataclass and 20 named archetype instances
Each archetype has non-empty name, role, capabilities, constraints, system_prompt, tools_allowed, interaction_style
ArchetypeRegistry provides get_archetype, list_archetypes, get_archetypes_by_role methods
All 3 new adapters are registered in AdapterRegistry._register_defaults()
All 3 new adapters are exported from nexus.adapters.__init__.py
tests/test_archetypes.py has 12+ test methods covering archetype system
tests/test_provider_adapters.py has 15+ test methods covering all 3 new adapters
All new .py files pass AST validation (valid Python 3.12 syntax)
verification: Verify registry.py includes all 3 new adapters in _register_defaults()
